text:
joseph: Quick sync — Keymesh (partner) wants to align on their on-prem HSM connector + cloud marketplace listing + a short joint announcement. They propose a validation window next Tuesday. Need security + legal signoff before we greenlight co-blog. @maya @tanya @chris @sam :eyes:

 tanya: High level asks from security: we need their KMS API spec, attestation/quotable FIPS status, and the HSM firmware hash. Also confirm whether they support remote attestation (TPM/CA) or just manual audit. If they support JWT-based attestation chaining that's ideal.

 maya: From legal: we require a co-marketing agreement addendum & an embargo SLA. Typical window is 48h pre-publish for approvals. If Keymesh wants to publish first, we need an approval step in their PR flow. I can send a quick addendum template — request: does marketing have a draft press blurb?

 chris: Ops checklist notes: connector runs as agent v2.1+ in customer infra. Need to validate network egress rules and mTLS to our ingestion endpoint. Minimum cert chain: leaf -> intermediate -> root; we need PEM bundle. For the dry-run, we'll need an engineer from Keymesh with SSH access to a staging node. Suggested quick firewall ports: 443 (agent -> svc), 8200 (metrics), 10250 (k8s agent), plus ephemeral for callbacks.

 sam: Docs/devex side — I'll own the marketplace listing and integration guide. Quick SCIM example for their IdP mapping we should verify with them: 
```
scim:users:
  externalId: "id"
  displayName: "name.formatted"
  emails: ["emails[0].value"]
  groups: "groups.display"
```
Also need sample SAML metadata and an IdP test user for end-to-end. I can draft the "Keymesh connector" doc and share a checklist.

 joseph: Action items summary: 
- tanya: request KMS API spec + attestation artifacts from Keymesh (owner: tanya) — due EOD Thursday (1755008634).
- maya: send co-marketing addendum + embargo template to Keymesh legal (owner: maya) — due EOD Wednesday.
- chris: schedule staging dry-run; confirm ports & cert expectations (owner: chris) — propose Mon for dry-run.
- sam: draft integration doc + SCIM/SAML samples (owner: sam) — first draft by next Tue morning.
I'll ping Keymesh (Amira) to lock down dates. If we get attestation + certs we can status the marketplace listing as "ready for announcement".

 deploy-bot: CI: marketplace-readme + connector-tests pipeline started: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/5421 — smoke tests queued. :rocket:

 tanya: One more: we should ask for HSM model and firmware revision in writing; some banks require specific module IDs. Also confirm key import/export policy — no export allowed.

 joseph: Good call. I'll add that to the ask list. Planning note: marketing needs a 3-line blurb + logo SVG by Fri. If anyone sees regulatory red flags (FIPS gaps, export flags), flag here asap.

 chris: I'll prepare a staging playbook (runbook + checklist) and post a link once ready. Expect it by EOD Friday.

 maya: I'll attach the NDA/addendum once I tweak our template. Expect ping in <48h>.

 joseph: Thanks all — I'll update partners thread after I hear back from Amira. Holding final announcement until attestation & legal signoff. :thumbsup:
